name: Fella‐Fe​tish!
source:
Main character decides to help his childhood friend and classmate Momoka with her summer homework. He promises to make three wishes come true if everything is done in time. To his surprise Momoka remembers this promise and suggests having a date at an amusement park. The second request is a kiss on a Ferris wheel. Protagonist proposes third wish himself by unzipping his pants. Naughty lessons continue from there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公决定帮助青梅竹马兼同班同学凉原桃华完成暑假作业，并承诺只要按时做完，就替她实现3个愿望。令他吃惊的是，桃华当真记得这份承诺，第一个愿望便是两人到游乐园约会。第二个愿望是在摩天轮上接吻。主人公则主动提出第三个愿望，同时拉开自己的裤链。从此，下流课程继续进行。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vndb-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
